The famously "closed on Sundays" chicken sandwich fast-food chain could soon be required to fire up the fryers and serve hungry travelers in some locations.

The New York State Assembly has put forth a new bill, known as the Rest Stop Restaurant Act, that would require food and beverage companies contracted to provide services along the Thruway and at the Port Authority in New York and New Jersey to stay open seven days a week.
Applegreen, an Irish convenience store chain with a portfolio of companies including Chick-fil-A, took over the leases of all Thruway Authority service areas in 2021.
To date, Chick-fil-A has opened at seven Thruway service areas.
The fast-food chain currently operates 2,988 restaurants across 48 states.
Chick-fil-A did not immediately respond to ABC News' request for comment.

One of the bill's sponsors, Assemblyman Tony Simone, spoke to ABC News Albany affiliate WTEN about the importance of ensuring that New York State's transportation facilities offer reliable food services.
Simone and the other bill sponsors are currently seeking co-sponsors to help pass the legislation during the current assembly session in Albany.

Taco Bell is turning up the heat with new menu items from burritos to hot sauce.

The popular Southern California-based fast-food chain announced two new launches on Thursday: the Flamin’ Hot Grilled Cheese Burrito and Frank's RedHot Diablo Sauce, to pair with the return of the fan-favorite crispy chicken menu.
First up, the burrito that boasts all the familiar flavors of Flamin' Hot Fritos.
The new Flamin' Hot Grilled Cheese Burrito from Taco Bell.

The limited-time innovation is made with an all-new Flamin' Hot rice with cheddar cheese powder,garlic, paprika and lime, Fritos Flamin' Hot corn chips for extra crunch and spice, and is layered with seasoned beef, nacho cheese sauce, creamy chipotle sauce, reduced-fat sour cream, and a three-cheese blend, wrapped in a tortilla that's grilled with a layer of cheese for a cheesy, spicy bite.
The new Flamin' Hot Grilled Cheese Burrito can be ordered in the Luxe Cravings Box.
The Flamin' Hot Grilled Cheese Burrito is now available nationwide for $5.49 à la carte or as part of the $9 Discovery Luxe Cravings Box, while supplies last.
Next up is the return of the crispy chicken lineup, which includes burritos, soft tacos, strips, and loaded nacho fries and now comes with the new Frank's RedHot Diablo Sauce.
The flavor mashup is described as a "creamy blend" that combines the signature buffalo flavor of Frank's RedHot with Taco Bell's signature Diablo heat and spicy ranch.
